nodes.name: Approved action webhook
nodes.notes: Receives a durable event payload from FounderOS or a retry worker.

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; if (!x.action_id || !x.owner || !x.due_date || !x.idempotency_key) throw new Error('Invalid approved-action payload'); return [{json:{...x, subject:`RelayOps action: ${x.description}`, body:`Assigned to ${x.owner}; due ${x.due_date}. ${x.rationale}`}}];

nodes.name: Validate and prepare assignment
nodes.notes: Validation only; does not approve or complete any business action.

nodes.name: Dispatch demonstration notification
nodes.notes: Use a local mock receiver by default. Configure Slack/email separately; never send automatically to real recipients.
